entry.title: OmniDiff Content-Aware Git Difftool Released
entry.content:
Links: github.com | hacker news

OmniDiff is an open-source, content-aware diff tool written in Rust that integrates with Git and Jujutsu as a difftool backend and formatter. Rather than relying solely on traditional line-by-line comparisons, it utilizes tree-sitter grammars to parse source code across 25 languages and applies specialized algorithms for binary formats including images, fonts, PDFs, and archives.

The tool features an interactive terminal user interface supporting 24-bit color, a headless batch mode for CI pipelines, and a JSON output option for programmatic workflows. By highlighting specific structural changes rather than whole modified lines, OmniDiff aims to reduce visual noise during code reviews.
